title: Rotate the master key (KEK)
caption: docs/mvp/runbooks/master-key-rotation.md and deployment §7. Both backend zones hold identical copies.

steps.title: Add the new key
steps.expect: `master-v2.key` 0400 in `/etc/velexis/keys/platform/` and `/etc/velexis/keys/ota/`; a lower version is refused.

steps.title: Switch new writes
steps.body: Set `MASTER_KEY_CURRENT=local:v2` in `platform-backend.env` and `ota-backend.env`; restart the four backend units.

steps.title: Re-wrap
steps.body: Run each backend's `secrets:rewrap` through `velexis-run platform …` and `velexis-run ota …`.
steps.expect: Both report zero rows left under `local:v1`.

steps.title: Remove v1 and back up
steps.body: Remove `master-v1.key` from both folders; back up `/etc/velexis` offline again.
